draft.title: Business plan: Bean There
sections: This plan sets out Bean There. It sells specialty coffee and pastries. Its customers are university students. It operates in a mid-sized city. From the declared market and share, target revenue is 1,800,000 and target volume is 15,000 units. Across the projected periods, revenue totals 4,500,000 and net income totals 360,000.
The business is Bean There. It sells specialty coffee and pastries. Its customers are university students. It operates in a mid-sized city.

The business is positioned as affordable specialty coffee. It will reach customers through a campus kiosk and social media. Its pricing approach is mid-market pricing.
The business will operate as follows: a single kiosk with two staff. It depends on a local roaster. Its capacity requirement is 120 cups a day.
The business will be run by the owner and one barista. Responsibilities are: the owner buys and manages; the barista serves.
A declared target share of 3.0% of a market of 60,000,000 at a price of 120 gives target revenue of 1,800,000 and 15,000 units.

At a declared fixed cost of 300,000, a price of 120 per unit and a variable cost of 55 per unit, the break-even quantity is 4,615.38 units and the break-even revenue is 553,846.15. The contribution margin is 65 per unit (54.2% of the price).
Depreciation on a cost of 500,000 to a salvage value of 50,000 over 5 periods totals 450,000, leaving a carrying amount of 50,000.

In period 1, revenue is 1,200,000, net income is 37,500 and closing cash is 99,280.82. In period 2, revenue is 1,500,000, net income is 120,000 and closing cash is 177,226.03. In period 3, revenue is 1,800,000, net income is 202,500 and closing cash is 337,671.23. Over the declared periods, revenue totals 4,500,000 and net income totals 360,000, closing with cash of 337,671.23 and equity of 610,000. The declared period-1 revenue is 1,200,000, against target revenue of 1,800,000 from the declared market share. The projected balance sheet balances at the opening date and at the end of every period, as the method checks.

At the declared base case, profit is 350,000. Across the declared changes, profit ranges from 124,000 at a price change of -10.0% and a volume change of -20.0%, to 624,000 at a price change of 10.0% and a volume change of 20.0%. Each cell is the profit identity at the changed price and volume; the unit cost and the fixed cost stay at the base case.

Across the declared changes, profit ranges from 124,000 at a price change of -10.0% and a volume change of -20.0%, to 624,000 at a price change of 10.0% and a volume change of 20.0%. Each cell is the profit identity at the changed price and volume; the unit cost and the fixed cost stay at the base case.
The owner names the following risks: a rent increase; low student footfall.

The business description, marketing, operations, management and risks are the student's input; the system did not verify them. The financial figures are arithmetic on the declared drivers, not a demand forecast. The market size, share, price, costs and opening balances are declarations, not retrieved facts. The sensitivity table changes price and volume only; unit cost and fixed cost stay at the base case.

The plan proposes Bean There. The declared market share supports target revenue of 1,800,000. The projected statements report net income of 360,000 over the declared periods from the declared drivers. The named risks and the limitations qualify the plan; every figure in it is a declared input or a core computation, not a forecast.

blocks.label: Market Size and Target Sales
blocks.what: Target revenue and units from your declared market size, share and price.

market_size.desc: the annual market size in your currency

target_share.desc: the share of the market you plan to win, a fraction above zero and at most one

blocks.label: Break-even
blocks.what: The quantity and revenue at which the declared price covers the declared costs.

expected_units.desc: optional expected sales volume, for the margin of safety

target_profit.desc: optional pre-tax profit target, for the required volume

blocks.label: Depreciation
blocks.what: The period depreciation charge and the carrying amount of an asset.

salvage.desc: expected salvage value at the end of the life, default 0

life.desc: useful life in whole periods, 1 to 40

blocks.label: Projected Financial Statements
blocks.what: Projected income statement, cash flow and balance sheet from your declared drivers.

revenue.desc: declared revenue for each period, one to ten periods

gross_margin_rate.desc: gross margin as a fraction of revenue, e.g. 0.40

operating_costs.desc: fixed operating costs each period, excluding depreciation and interest

interest.desc: interest expense each period; omit when loan terms are declared

principal_repayment.desc: loan principal repaid each period; omit when loan terms are declared

loan_principal.desc: optional opening loan principal; with the rate and years, the interest and principal are derived

loan_annual_rate.desc: optional annual interest rate on the opening loan, e.g. 0.09

loan_years.desc: optional number of level annual payments; must equal the number of periods

capex.desc: optional capital expenditure each period, default zero

tax_rate.desc: tax rate on positive pre-tax profit, default 0

inventory_days.desc: inventory days of cost of sales, default 0

payable_days.desc: payable days of cost of sales, default 0

opening_equity.desc: opening equity; the opening balance sheet must balance

blocks.label: Sensitivity
blocks.what: Profit across declared price and volume changes.

price_changes.desc: price changes as fractions, e.g. -0.1 for -10%

volume_changes.desc: volume changes as fractions, one to five

plan.why: The plan composes your own description, the retrieved market evidence and the plan-level computations in the order a reader expects: the business, the market, how it operates, the numbers, the risks and the conclusion.
plan.misses: It does not invent a market, a customer, a cost or a forecast. Every number comes from the declared inputs through the frozen core, and every gap is named.
